notes.title: Hotfix 1.4
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

I have deployed the new update yesterday in order to fix additional issues,

Fixed a game crash that was linked to enemies spawn system,

Fixed a crash that was caused by audio memory usage,

Fixed collisione audio for some materials

temporarily removed the mine placing system as i Need to rework some logic,

Reduced time to every two minutes for waves passing and points deployment

added exclusion to the folders "user" that Store the game menu settings so in future updates It won't be overwrited

The next update will come in the end of the next week 

It Will come with additional game optimization both for performances and for game data (i aim to reduce the game size from around 9 GB to 6GB)

new game menu and HUD design
(Health / Ammo counters)

reintegrate the new mine system

Thanks you ,
Luca : )

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1 live!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I have just released a new hotfix wich have updated some other bugs reported,

Fixed a bug where once the player die , sometimes the game doesn't reload Itself

Fixed a bug where the invincibility mode were not correct triggered

Fixed a bug where the Place mine system wasn't working for one Window entrance (you can now Place mine on Windows and doora every two minutes)

Fixed a bug where the player could exit the playing area 

Reducted the points amount Need for ssome weapons to unlock

Enemies spawn general rework

Removed 'H' key for debug

What's next ?
Have a first look of what's coming : )


[previewyoutube=FR6mvXTc9dA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Thanks for your time,
Luca ☺️

notes.title: Update 1.0 Live!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I just updated the game fixing some bugs that were reported and also improved a few things:


 enemy spawns have been delayed by a few minutes to give players time to look around and examine the game map,

 Fixed a bug where enemies were unable to go down to the basement

 Fixed a bug where points were not scaled correctly 
      i have left the 'H' key on the keyboard as "debug-mode", 
      clicking it will add 1000 points, make good use of it!!

 Fixed some bugs where the menu loaded slowly on some PCs, I'm not sure I've solved it 100%, I hope so!

 General rework of menu design

in addition to these a series of minor bugs,

have been reported also that sometimes the enemies cannot see the player ,
i'm investigating the issue to resolve it : )

Thank you, as always I await your feedback!

Luca
